34 instruments, London sessions 2016-10-24 to 2022-12-30 (about 52,000 instrument-days). The chosen walk-forward lines exist only from 2020-08-24 inside this window, so every 'chosen' number is 2020-08 to 2022. 2023 onward is not looked at.

On average the chosen lines are honest: 25.6% of sides go past p75 [24.4, 26.8] against 25%, and 10.4% past p90 against 10%. But not by class: FX majors 27.3% [25.8, 28.9], gold 21.0% [19.0, 23.1], indices 23.5% [22.1, 24.8]. A stop at the p75 line sits too close on majors and too far on gold and indices.

The miss persists. For the plain σ, yesterday's realised-variance miss correlates +0.50 with today's (shuffled: within ±0.02) and is still +0.09 ten days later. The chosen σ, which already feeds back yesterday's and the 5-day miss, halves it to +0.25, but it is not gone.

Feedback still pays on the variance forecast: chosen σ + an error-feedback term has 0.715 [0.666, 0.765] of the plain σ's QLIKE loss, against 0.778 [0.714, 0.831] for the chosen σ alone (2021-22, about 8% better). Even yesterday's realised variance beats the plain σ (0.84). The feedback betas were stable 2018-22 for the plain σ; the chosen ones rest on one year, so treat this as a lead.

On the bands it is much smaller. After a big over-day, 28.3% of sides go past the chosen p75 next day (plain lines 33-34%); after a big under-day 22.4%. Rescaling σ by recent misses cuts band (pinball) loss by 0.7-0.9%; adaptive conformal keeps 25% on average but makes the loss slightly worse (1.002-1.028) and does not fix the quiet-regime miss (29% beyond p75 in quiet regimes, 21-22% in busy ones, for every band built on the plain σ).

Intraday, range used so far is information, not exhaustion. If vol were exactly σ, the most-used tenth at 13:00 would leave 0.80 of the usual range to come and the least-used 1.30. Real days: 1.04 and 1.06, flat, close to the benchmark where today's vol is simply off all day. At 16:00 the most-used tenth leaves 1.25 times the usual.

Drift alarms have something to find: a textbook CUSUM on the plain σ's miss fires about 27 times per 1,000 instrument-days against about 4 on the same misses shuffled in time, every year. For the stop: widen after over-days and narrow after quiet days, by about 3 points of hit rate on the chosen lines; do not shrink a stop because the morning was wide.
